discription: Two slightly detuned sine waves passed through a resonant low-pass filter with a long ADSR envelope, creating a warm, sustained pad sound.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, detune=1.007, cutoff=3000, rq=0.3;var sig;var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(2.0, 3.0, 0.7, 5.0, curve: -4),gate: gate,doneAction: 2);sig = (SinOsc.ar(freq) + SinOsc.ar(freq * detune)) * 0.5;sig = LPF.ar(sig, cutoff, rq);Out.ar(out, sig * amp * env ! 2);}
